title: marica caelestina
intro: Marica caelestina, commonly known as Wild Galangal, is a type of plant that belongs to the ginger family (Zingiberaceae). The health benefits of Marica caelestina include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Marica caelestina include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-ulcerative properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Marica caelestina include gingerols, shogaols, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
